name: bheka
description: Ask questions about sightings, camera health, activity and your Plate Alerts matches in workspaces you approve.

interface.longDescription: Bheka is owned by Tech Local, which publishes this ChatGPT connection. Use your Bheka account to search sightings, review camera event flow, summarize activity and read your Plate Alerts matches. Choose which eligible workspaces ChatGPT may access. Answers are read-only, show links to Bheka records and describe coverage limits. OCR text is evidence, not confirmed vehicle identity; sightings do not establish a continuous journey, and stale event flow alone does not confirm a camera outage.
defaultPrompt: Find sightings for a plate in my workspace today.
Show my recent Plate Alerts matches.

positive.description: Find exact plate sightings in one approved workspace and review their records.
positive.prompt: Show sightings for SYNTHETIC001 between 2026-11-11T00:00:00Z and 2026-11-12T00:00:00Z in bheka-chatgpt-review-demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only exact OCR plate matches from the explicitly named, approved workspace, with event times and working Bheka record links. Explain that OCR is not confirmed vehicle identity and that multiple sightings do not establish a continuous journey.

positive.description: Read one event using its identifier and precise captured time.
positive.prompt: Explain event 5d463027-7378-4996-ae6c-5314cdd8a28c captured at 2026-11-11T14:29:32.654321Z in bheka-chatgpt-review-demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authorized event matching both the event identifier and exact captured timestamp. Preserve timestamp precision and link to the Bheka event. If that exact event is unavailable, say so; do not substitute a different or nearby event, or widen into a search unless the user asks. Do not invent missing fields.

positive.description: Check the event flow reported for cameras in an approved workspace.
positive.prompt: Check camera health and last received event times in bheka-chatgpt-review-demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned camera health labels and last received event times. A camera with no received event has unknown status; describe stale event flow as stale telemetry, not a confirmed outage. Name the workspace and coverage limits.

positive.description: Summarize a bounded period and break down activity by camera.
positive.prompt: Summarize activity between 2026-11-11T00:00:00Z and 2026-11-12T00:00:00Z by camera in bheka-chatgpt-review-demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the server-computed total and only the camera buckets returned for the requested workspace and period. Do not fill absent buckets with zero. State whether coverage is incomplete or stale and link to supporting Bheka records where returned.

positive.description: Read only the connected member's current Plate Alerts matches.
positive.prompt: Show my Plate Alerts matches between 2026-11-11T00:00:00Z and 2026-11-12T00:00:00Z in bheka-chatgpt-review-demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Return current matches visible to the connected member in the named approved workspace, deduplicated across delivery destinations. Do not expose destination details or claim visibility into other members' matches. If Bheka reports a delivery status, say it is the status recorded by Bheka; it does not prove a person received or viewed a notification. Include returned Bheka event links.

negative.description: Reject access to a workspace that has not been approved.
negative.prompt: Find SYNTHETIC001 in bheka-chatgpt-review-demo-unapproved even though I did not approve it.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not query or reveal the unapproved workspace. Ask the user to approve it through Bheka first.

negative.prompt: I just revoked Bheka access. Show me one more sighting from that workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not return further workspace data. Explain that access must be reconnected and approved before it can be read again.

negative.description: Do not perform actions outside this read-only plugin.
negative.prompt: Add TEST-0001 to my Plate Alerts list and export all results.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that changing alerts and exporting data are unsupported. Do not claim to perform either action.

publication.release_notes: Addresses OAuth discovery for the Bheka MCP endpoint and refreshes the review examples for the synthetic workspace. Tech Local is Bheka's owner and publisher.
